ideas.pitch: An automated OSINT pipeline that aggregates public metadata, domain records, and social leaks into an interactive threat actor graph.
ideas.problem_statement: OSINT and Digital Forensics challenges in Pinaka CTF require correlating disparate public data sources manually under tight time constraints.
ideas.title: OSINT-Graph: Automated Social and Infrastructure Threat Mapping
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines advanced graph intelligence patterns from Bito with real-time network attack simulation concepts from GraphGuard, providing judges an automated tool that drastically reduces manual OSINT investigation time.

ideas.pitch: A local LLM and symbolic execution wrapper that parses stripped ELF binaries, identifies common memory corruption patterns, and suggests Ghidra scripting patches.
ideas.problem_statement: Reverse Engineering and Binary Exploitation tracks require deep manual assembly analysis and tedious pattern matching.
ideas.title: AutoBinary: AI-Assisted Static Binary Analyzer and Exploit Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the hardest core technical domain (Binary Exploitation) with genuinely difficult engineering, mimicking the technical depth of GraphGuard and reportr.

ideas.pitch: A deep learning toolkit designed to detect, extract, and reverse hidden payloads in complex steganographic images, audio files, and network traffic.
ideas.problem_statement: Steganography and Miscellaneous challenges demand rapid identification of anomalous hidden data carriers hidden within media.
ideas.title: StegoNet: Neural Steganography Detection and Extraction Suite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses custom detection models and data extraction techniques that solve a notoriously time-consuming CTF bottleneck, aligning with hard engineering win patterns.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent cryptanalysis workbench that identifies weak padding oracle vulnerabilities, broken custom crypto schemes, and lattice-based key recovery.
ideas.problem_statement: Cryptography challenges often rely on identifying subtle implementation flaws in custom ciphers or RSA parameter weaknesses.
ideas.title: CryptoFlow: Automated Cryptanalytic Oracle and Cipher Identifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves complex mathematical security challenges with high functional execution, appealing directly to NFSU Chennai's focus on advanced forensic and cryptographic problem-solving.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous browser-based agent that navigates complex JavaScript single-page apps to uncover hidden API endpoints, CORS misconfigurations, and prototype pollution.
ideas.problem_statement: Web Exploitation challenges at national CTFs increasingly feature modern JavaScript frameworks and hidden API logic.
ideas.title: WebFuzz-AI: Intelligent DOM-Based Vulnerability Hunting Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs multi-agent automated scraping and vulnerability detection workflows similar to WILDSCAN and GraphGuard, making it an exceptionally polished offensive security asset.
